name: Brine Handaxe
summary: A salt-crusted handaxe that chills the creatures it cuts.
description: Sailors hang these over the bunks of the ships they sail on. A thin crust of salt reforms on the blade every morning.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with it, the creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
